leadership.name: Poonam Kumari
leadership.bio: Poonam founded VSJ AI Labs with a vision to build compliance-first AI and enterprise technology that helps organizations modernize operations, improve efficiency, and accelerate digital transformation. She owns business strategy, P&L, client success, partnerships, and organizational growth — keeping every engagement aligned with industry standards, regulatory expectations, and the measurable outcomes customers actually ask for. Her focus is on building VSJ into a long-term, trusted partner for BFSI, Healthcare, and Enterprise SaaS leaders.

leadership.name: Yogesh Kumar Upadhyay
leadership.bio: Yogesh brings 11+ years of hands-on engineering across Banking and Insurance — including microservices for Max Life Insurance policy management at Infosys, partner-bank integrations with Axis and Yes Bank, and cloud-native platforms at Hexaware. At VSJ AI Labs he owns technology strategy, engineering excellence, and cloud modernization alongside delivery governance, program execution, and quality assurance across client engagements — ensuring engineering rigor, on-time releases, and tight collaboration between business and technology teams.
